---
name: context-instructions
description: >-
  INSTRUCTION GENERATOR. USE FOR: Phase 11, refresh Enterprise Context after
  Intent or Structure changes, repair generated-section merges. DO NOT USE FOR:
  MCP configuration, authentication, docs, changelog, code, commits, or
  deployment. INVOKES: files, helper, session_state, ask_user for manual edits.
license: MIT
metadata:
  version: 0.1.0
  user-invocable: true
---

Load servers, sources, health, `distilled_intent`, ADRP drafts/accepted imports,
ASRP drafts, optional execution manifest, and changelog. Missing input is a gap.

1. Draft one `## Enterprise Context` section containing
   `<!-- generated by context-instructions -->`.
2. Include tools/sources, Intent, constraints, applicable ADRP IDs/status/
   fingerprints, ASRP IDs/status/fingerprints, manifest path/gates, autonomy
   (`PROCEED`/`ALWAYS ASK`/`NEVER`), topology, workflows, and changelog link.
3. Only accepted eligible imports are active. Preserve URI, authority, scope,
   status, review/expiry, and conflicts; omit sensitive source content.
4. Above 80 lines or ~2000 tokens, trim guidance first, never constraints.
5. Resolve `context_artifacts.py` from project, `.ape-context`, unified plugin,
   then legacy plugin. Write a temporary section and run:

```bash
python3 <helper> merge \
  --target .github/copilot-instructions.md \
  --section-file <temp>
```

Use `--dry-run` for evaluation. The helper atomically creates/appends/replaces
while preserving other content. If it reports `manual edits`, ask before
rerunning with `--allow-manual`. Remove the temporary file.

Helper failure leaves the target unchanged. Context and profile drafts remain
inactive until `context-quality` and `context-ratify` pass.
